description: Free demo of the paid strategy-validation check. Send periodic NET returns as decimals (0.01 = 1%); only the first 60 observations and 300 bootstrap resamples are used. Returns annualised Sharpe, block-bootstrap 95% CI, probabilistic and deflated Sharpe (corrects for n_trials), max drawdown, min track-record length and a verdict. Statistical diagnostic on supplied data, not investment advice.

n_trials.description: honest count of strategy variants tried before picking this one
